text_block_list.text: One night, as the Takarazuka Kinen approached—

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text: âLapis!! Cure!! Now!!

text_block_list.name: Lapis & Cure
text_block_list.text:
—Yaaaaah!!!
—Haaaaah!!!

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
The lead widened.
A distance from which overtaking would normally be utterly impossible—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —HAAH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
...! What incredible acceleration...!
But even so, this isn't enough to—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(Yes, more!!
The current me knows no limits!!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAAH!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...――

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —Did I... do it?

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text: I... I think I just saw... something incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text:
Ah...!
What incredible running...!!
—I certainly saw it too.

Bubble Gum Fellow's running showed no signs of limits;
it was nothing short of an explosion of pure potential...!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I did it!! With all my might!!
With more than everything I had!! I raaaaan!!!"

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
—You've completely surpassed your past self.
And left it far, far behind.

text_block_list.name: Waltz of Shadow
text_block_list.text:
Bubble. Trainer-san.
Thank you both... so much for your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Waltz...!
Even with all your work,
you came to the academy so many times—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Lapis and Cure too!
Even though you're on break, you've stayed with me the whole time...!"

text_block_list.name: Sol Lapis
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry about it~!
That's what the Heavenly Kings' bond is all about!"

text_block_list.name: Holy Cure
text_block_list.text: Plus, I got to see a wonderful run. That alone made it more than worth it.
choice_data_list: Thank you all so much, from me as well...!
Thank you all so much, from me as well...!

text_block_list.text:
Thanks to all the members of the Big Four supporting Bubble Gum Fellow's
training, Bubble Gum Fellow was able to successfully carry out the plan.
All that's left is to unleash the fruits of my labor upon the racing world at the Takarazuka Kinen...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna win the Takarazuka Kinen. Absolutely.
With the running style we all built together!
So—"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Let's celebrate in the winner's circle!
This victory is ours!
The fateful day of the Takarazuka Kinen has arrived—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to today's Takarazuka Kinen, it's gotta be Marvelous Sunday~!
Without a doubt, the strongest of this era!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow is running too, but I wonder.
Her recent slump is still fresh in my mind,
so it's hard to be sure...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Let's see if you have what it takes to carve a path forward.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...... The 『Takarazuka Kinen』, huh?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Prix, where the "dreams" of racing fans gather.
In such a race, I will run to make those dreams swell once more—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...Doesn't that just sound
like a total blast...?!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, there could be no better stage than this...!
Yeah, there's no better stage than this...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —...Well, I'd better be going now.
choice_data_list: Go and run your heart out!
Go out there and run your heart out!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Yeah—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
...In today's race,
I plan to run with everything I've got,
like never before.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I don't know what'll happen
if that happens, but—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm not scared at all.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"Because no matter how many times it takes,
I can always let my dreams swell anew."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ...Because that's what you taught me.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Wait for me in the winner's circle
with Waltz and the others!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Once you win, we'll all be there to welcome you back!
Yeah! We'll all be there to welcome you back when you win!

text_block_list.text: —I've been waiting for you, Bubble!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Marvelous...!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(Incredible...!
She's gotten so much stronger
than when we clashed at last year's Tenno Sho (Autumn)...!)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (Still... that goes for me as well.)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
I'm so happy you were waiting for me.
You were thinking about me, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yup☆
Because Bubble is—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Because she's a super-marvelous Umamusume
who has overcome so much pain!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
You know, Bubble,
I think I understand. ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
How overwhelmingly painful it is.
And how difficult it is to face it.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Both of them—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Because I went through that too...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Because I've fought beside you.
...That's how I know!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Marvelous—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(............That's right.
Marvelous is a girl who has suffered through so many injuries and illnesses in her career up to this point.)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: (She overcame all of it, and now stands before me as the strongest Umamusume of this era...)

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
(...I suppose that's why her words
carry such weight with me—)

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Having overcome hardship,
today's Bubble is the most marvelous Bubble in history☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Being able to run with Bubble like that makes me feel super Marvelous☆★☆

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ......You're really right.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: ――I make this declaration, Marvelous.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Today, I will defeat you.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Win... and leap to the pinnacle of this era!!
I'll make everyone's dreams swell once again!!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Let's make this the most Marvelous race ever!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!!
I won't lose, Bubble!!
